cost.basis: sum of per-run prompt_result usage x list prices; not billing data

environment.model_note: not observed: each generation-1 prompt was abandoned by SIGTERM, so no prompt_result usage or model id was returned; the session's model option was "default"

cost.basis: upper bound per run: the last usage_update `used` tokens priced as cache writes plus 500 output tokens, at list prices; the generation-1 prompt was abandoned, so no prompt_result usage exists; not billing data

environment.model_note: Every run's main model is claude-opus-5[1m]; each run also makes one small claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 call (about 950 tokens).

cost.basis: sum over prompt_result _meta.quota.model_usage, each model priced at its own list price (Opus 5: in 5 / out 25 / cache write 6.25 / cache read 0.50; Haiku 4.5: in 1 / out 5 / cache write 1.25 / cache read 0.10 USD per MTok); upper-bound estimate; not billing data
